sentences.text: Shri Gourav Shrivastava - Advocate for the petitioner  Ms. Mehul Shukla - Panel Lawyer for the State.

ORDER By this petition preferred under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioners have raised a grievance to the effect that though application (Annexure P/3) was submitted by them on 08.08.2024, but no action thereupon has been taken and reference in terms of Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 has not been made as yet.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 02. From the record, it is seen that on 08.08.2024 an application (Annexure P/3) though untitled but presumably under Section 64 of the Act, 2013 has been made by the petitioners before the Sub Divisional Officer by impleading the Collector, District Agar Malwa as a party thereto.

In terms of Section 64 of the Act, reference to the appropriate authority has to be made by the Collector within a period of 30 days from the date of receipt of the application by stating the information required under Section 65 of the Act, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31453 2 WP-31911-2024 2013.
Admittedly, a period of more than 30 days has expired since filing of the application by the petitioners.

03. It is hence directed that the Collector, District Agar Malwa shall advert to the application dated 08.08.2024 (Annexure P/3) preferred by the petitioners and shall make reference to the authority in Mangu Gurjar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33253502/
1 terms of Section 64 of the Act, 2013.

entities.text: Mangu Gurjar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Let the same be done within a period of 45 days from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
The petitioners are also directed to file a copy of the application dated 08.08.2024 (Annexure P/3) before the Collector, District Agar Malwa within a period of ten days from today.
04. With the aforesaid directions, the petition stands disposed off.
